title: {{id}}: the {{repositoryName}} repository
objective: Develop the software in the git repository {{repository}} through System: each change a board task, written in a worktree of its own, reviewed, checked on its exact tree, and landed on {{targetBranch}}.
scope: the repository {{repository}} and its branch {{targetBranch}}, nothing else on this host
the commands its setup and checks need, as the policy lists them (this project's policy-change request)
board tasks of the algorithm-development template, started by the project's own lead session (D88)
nonGoals: no push, release, or deploy: a landing merges into the local branch on the operator's approval
no change to System itself, its policy, or another project's repository
no egress beyond what each Worker already declares

doneWhen.statement: A first task's result is reviewed, checked, and landed on {{targetBranch}}
The repository's required checks pass on every landed result
The operator closes the project as achieved

stopRules.condition: No result landed after 10 attempts across the project's tasks

milestones.title: Setup and checks run in a worktree; a first task lands on {{targetBranch}}
